tools.name: chess_list_variants
tools.description: List all available chess variants with descriptions, board sizes, and rules.
tools.example: List all tactical chess variants
tools.returns: Array of variant objects with key, label, group, board size

tools.name: chess_get_legal_moves
tools.description: Get all legal moves for a position in any of 70+ variants.
tools.example: What moves can white play in Atomic Chess after 1. e4 e5?
tools.returns: Array of moves with type annotations (capture, castle, promotion)

tools.name: chess_analyze_position
tools.description: Evaluate a position using the engine. Returns best move and principal variation.
tools.example: Analyze this position in Capablanca Chess: [FEN]
tools.returns: Best move, evaluation score, principal variation line

tools.name: chess_validate_move
tools.description: Check whether a specific move is legal with human-readable explanations.
tools.example: Can the knight on b1 move to d2 in this position?
tools.returns: Legal/illegal verdict with reason (pinned, blocked, wrong turn)

tools.name: chess_make_moves
tools.description: Play a sequence of moves and return the resulting game state.
tools.example: Play 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 in standard chess
tools.returns: Resulting FEN, game status, and full move history

tools.name: chess_get_opening_book
tools.description: Look up opening book moves for a position in any variant.
tools.example: What are the book moves after 1. d4 in King of the Hill?
tools.returns: Known continuations from the variant opening book

tools.name: chess_generate_puzzle
tools.description: Serve a random puzzle from 1,557 pre-generated puzzles across 66 variants (plus standard). Includes SVG board, rating, themes, and solution.
tools.example: Give me an atomic chess puzzle rated above 1200
tools.returns: FEN, SVG board image, solution, rating, themes, variant info

tools.name: chess_list_puzzle_types
tools.description: Discover available puzzle types with counts and rating ranges. Filterable by variant.
tools.example: What puzzle types are available for Atomic Chess?
tools.returns: List of variant:type keys with puzzle counts and rating ranges

tools.name: chess_render_svg
tools.description: Render a board position as a self-contained SVG image. Supports all board sizes (4x8 to 12x8) and 6 themes.
tools.example: Render the starting position of Grand Chess with cosmic theme
tools.returns: Complete SVG string with pieces, board squares, and coordinate labels

tools.name: hex_list_games
tools.description: List all hex map games with their map types, layouts, and style options.
tools.example: What hex map games are available?
tools.returns: Array of game configs with sizes, layouts, and render styles

tools.name: hex_generate_map
tools.description: Generate a seeded hex map for any supported game.
tools.example: Generate a 6-player Nukes map with seed 'volcano'
tools.returns: Full hex grid with terrain types, coordinates, and metadata

tools.name: hex_get_info
tools.description: Inspect a hex coordinate: terrain, neighbors, distances.
tools.example: What terrain is at position (2, -1) on this Talisman map?
tools.returns: Hex details, adjacent hexes, nearest points of interest

tools.name: hex_compute_fov
tools.description: Compute field-of-view from a position respecting line-of-sight.
tools.example: What can a unit at (0,0) see with range 4, mountains blocking?
tools.returns: Visible and blocked hexes within range

tools.name: hex_export_svg
tools.description: Export a generated map as an SVG string for rendering.
tools.example: Export the current Nukes map as SVG with labels
tools.returns: Complete SVG string ready for embedding or download

tools.name: hex_pathfind
tools.description: Find shortest path between two hexes avoiding terrain.
tools.example: Find path from (0,0) to (3,2) avoiding water and mountains
tools.returns: Path array with distance, or unreachable verdict

tools.name: rules_list_games
tools.description: List all game families in the rules library with variant counts, player info, and URLs.
tools.example: What board games does Moddable Games have rules for?
tools.returns: Array of game objects with slug, title, tagline, players, variantCount

tools.name: rules_get_game
tools.description: Get full metadata and variant list for a specific game family.
tools.example: What variants of Backgammon are documented?
tools.returns: Game metadata, variant list, summary, rules URL

tools.name: rules_get_variant
tools.description: Get rules content for a specific variant within a game family.
tools.example: What are the rules for Acey-Deucey?
tools.returns: Rules text, headings, entry count, direct URL to variant page

tools.name: rules_search
tools.description: Search the entire rules library by keyword across all games and variants.
tools.example: Which games use dice for movement?
tools.returns: Ranked results with game, section, heading, and matching content

tools.name: rules_random
tools.description: Pick a random game or variant from the library. Optionally filter by game family.
tools.example: Surprise me with a random board game variant
tools.returns: Random game metadata or variant rules content

tools.name: piece_gallery_search
tools.description: Search and filter piece sets from the gallery (96 sets, 2,550 SVGs across 19 game families). Filter by family, license, author, or search by name.
tools.example: Find all CC0-licensed shogi piece sets
tools.returns: Array of matching sets with metadata, piece counts, and preview URLs

tools.name: piece_gallery_get_set
tools.description: Get full details for a specific piece set including all piece files, SVG URLs, license info, and a rendered PNG preview.
tools.example: Show me the Chessnut piece set details
tools.returns: Full manifest with piece list, direct SVG URLs, preview image URL

tools.name: piece_gallery_stats
tools.description: Get aggregate statistics for the piece gallery: set counts by family, license distribution, author breakdown.
tools.example: How many piece sets are in the gallery?
tools.returns: Total sets, total SVGs, family/license/author breakdowns

tools.name: ti4_draw_objectives
tools.description: Draw random public objectives for a TI4 game round with expansion filtering.
tools.example: Draw 5 Stage 1 objectives with Prophecy of Kings
tools.returns: Array of objective cards with text and expansion source

tools.name: ti4_draw_agendas
tools.description: Draw random agenda cards for the TI4 agenda phase with for/against text.
tools.example: Draw 2 agendas from the base game
tools.returns: Agenda cards with title, type, for/against effects

tools.name: ti4_draft_factions
tools.description: Run a Milty-style faction draft with configurable pool size and ban lists.
tools.example: Draft for 6 players, 3 choices each, ban Winnu
tools.returns: Per-player faction options to choose from

tools.name: nukes_setup_generator
tools.description: Generate random starting territory assignments for a Nukes game.
tools.example: Set up a 4-player Nukes game with seed 'volcano'
tools.returns: Territory assignments per player with map seed

tools.name: colony_dice_odds
tools.description: Calculate 2d6 probability for Catan-style resource numbers on your settlements.
tools.example: What are my odds with settlements on 5, 6, 8, 9?
tools.returns: Per-number probability, combined odds, expected rolls

tools.name: mancala_simulate_move
tools.description: Simulate a mancala sow from a pit and return the resulting board state.
tools.example: Sow from pit 3 in a Kalah game
tools.returns: New board state, captures, extra turn status

tools.name: mancala_legal_moves
tools.description: List legal pits to sow from for the current mancala player.
tools.example: What moves can player 1 make?
tools.returns: Array of pit indices with seeds available

tools.name: morris_legal_moves
tools.description: List legal moves in Nine Men's Morris across place/slide/fly phases.
tools.example: What moves can player 1 make in the sliding phase?
tools.returns: Array of moves with type, from, and to positions

tools.name: morris_detect_mill
tools.description: Check if a position forms a mill (three in a row) in Nine Men's Morris.
tools.example: Does placing at position 4 form a mill?
tools.returns: Boolean isMill plus the specific mill line(s) formed

tools.name: ur_roll_dice
tools.description: Roll four tetrahedral dice for the Royal Game of Ur (binary, sum 0-4).
tools.example: Roll the Ur dice
tools.returns: Individual die results and total (0-4)

tools.name: ur_legal_moves
tools.description: List legal moves for a Royal Game of Ur position given a dice roll.
tools.example: What can player 1 do with a roll of 3?
tools.returns: Array of moves: enter, move, capture, or bear off

tools.name: pachisi_roll_cowries
tools.description: Roll cowrie shells for Pachisi or long dice for Chaupar.
tools.example: Roll the Pachisi shells
tools.returns: Faces up, move value, grace status, extra turn

tools.name: oracle_list_games
tools.description: List all 10 supported RPG systems with available features (tables, entities).
tools.example: What RPG systems are available?
tools.returns: Array of games with IDs, labels, table counts, entity counts

tools.name: oracle_list_tables
tools.description: List oracle/random tables for a game system (Starforged, Ironsworn, Maze Rats, Cairn, Dungeon World, Knave).
tools.example: What oracle tables are available for Cairn?
tools.returns: Array of tables with IDs, names, roll types, and categories

tools.name: oracle_roll
tools.description: Roll on a specific oracle/random table from any supported system.
tools.example: Roll on the Cairn dungeon-themes table
tools.returns: Dice roll and result text from the table

tools.name: oracle_ask
tools.description: Ask the Oracle a yes/no question with likelihood modifier. Implements match detection for twists.
tools.example: Ask the oracle with 'likely' likelihood: does the NPC cooperate?
tools.returns: Verdict (yes/no/strong yes/strong no), roll, match status

tools.name: oracle_scene
tools.description: Generate a narrative seed using recipes (Starforged, Ironsworn, Maze Rats, Cairn, Dungeon World, Knave) or custom table lists.
tools.example: Generate a Cairn NPC encounter
tools.returns: Composed narrative paragraph with individual roll elements

tools.name: oracle_list_recipes
tools.description: List predefined scene recipes across all RPG systems with tables and game support.
tools.example: What Cairn recipes are available?
tools.returns: Array of recipes with ID, name, game, description, tables

tools.name: oracle_interpret
tools.description: Resolve oracle cross-references like 'Action + Theme' or 'Roll twice'.
tools.example: Interpret the oracle result 'Descriptor + Focus'
tools.returns: Expanded results from following the reference chain

tools.name: oracle_table_view
tools.description: View the complete contents of an oracle table with all roll ranges and results.
tools.example: Show me the full Starforged Theme oracle table
tools.returns: All entries with min/max roll ranges and result text

tools.name: oracle_encounter
tools.description: Generate a D&D 5e or Pathfinder 1e encounter with CR-appropriate monsters, terrain, and loot.
tools.example: Generate a hard Pathfinder encounter for 4 level-7 players in a dungeon
tools.returns: Monster group, terrain, XP budget, and magic item loot

tools.name: rpg_list_categories
tools.description: List entity categories for an RPG: spells, monsters, classes, equipment, skills, bestiary, etc.
tools.example: What browseable content does D&D 5e have?
tools.returns: Array of categories with IDs, labels, and item counts

tools.name: rpg_search
tools.description: Full-text search across RPG entities: spells, monsters, equipment, classes, and more.
tools.example: Search for 'fire' spells in Pathfinder
tools.returns: Matching entities with game, category, and key fields

tools.name: rpg_browse
tools.description: Browse entities in a category with pagination. Explore spells, monsters, equipment.
tools.example: Browse D&D 5e monsters, page 2
tools.returns: Paginated entity list with total count and page info

tools.name: rpg_get_entity
tools.description: Get full details of a specific RPG entity by name with exact and fuzzy matching.
tools.example: Look up the spell Fireball in D&D 5e
tools.returns: Complete entity data with all available fields

tools.name: rpg_random
tools.description: Get random entities from an RPG system for inspiration or encounter prep.
tools.example: Give me 3 random Cairn monsters
tools.returns: Random entity picks with full detail

tools.name: dice_roll
tools.description: Roll dice using standard notation. Supports any combination of dice, modifiers, and multiple rolls.
tools.example: Roll 2d6+3 for a sword attack
tools.returns: Individual dice results, total, and breakdown

tools.name: ti4_random_factions
tools.description: Generate random faction assignments for a Twilight Imperium 4e game session.
tools.example: Pick factions for 6 players with Prophecy of Kings
tools.returns: Array of faction assignments with colours and home systems

tools.name: coin_flip
tools.description: Flip a coin or pick randomly from a custom list of options.
tools.example: Flip a coin to decide who goes first
tools.returns: The winning option plus full options list

tools.name: team_split
tools.description: Randomly split players into balanced teams. Handles odd numbers.
tools.example: Split 7 players into 2 teams
tools.returns: Team assignments with member lists

tools.name: jam_status
tools.description: Get the current Mod Jam status: active/inactive, theme, base game, and submission count.
tools.example: Is there a Mod Jam running right now?
tools.returns: Jam state, theme, base game, time remaining

tools.name: jam_timer
tools.description: Get the countdown timer for the current Mod Jam phase.
tools.example: How much time is left in the jam?
tools.returns: Phase name, time remaining, deadline

tools.name: jam_vote
tools.description: Get current vote standings for the active Mod Jam vote.
tools.example: What are the current jam vote results?
tools.returns: Anonymised tallies per option
